exam_scheme.note: DNB-PDCET (Diplomate of National Board Post Diploma Centralized Entrance Test) is a single-window ranking examination conducted by NBEMS for admission to Post Diploma DNB (Broad Specialty) 2-year secondary DNB training courses across 14 medical specialties in accredited hospitals nationwide. The examination is conducted as a Computer Based Test (CBT) consisting of 120 multiple-choice questions carrying 480 marks with a duration of 2 hours (120 minutes). Marking scheme: 4 marks for each correct response, deduction of 1 mark for each incorrect response (25% negative marking). The question paper for each diploma specialty contains questions exclusively from the curriculum of that respective post-graduate medical diploma specialty. Merit list is prepared specialty-wise based on CBT score.
